screen.rank: Fewest G421 wins first, tie by increasing opponent ID. Frozen greedy screen only, not final evaluation.

training.retainBaselineActors: Keep existing assignments until per-rank quota; fill remaining slots in increasing actor ID with ranked deficits.

evaluation.primary: weakness minus control vs Integrated Strategy; equal weight per replicate; inference on evaluation seeds conditional on four resulting checkpoints, not across arbitrary training runs.
evaluation.secondary: weakness minus control vs AQ; weakness vs control head-to-head; separate family, two simultaneous intervals.
evaluation.criterion: Only consider longer confirmation if primary lower bound > 0, both replicate primary estimates > 0, and secondary AQ lower bound > -0.02. Do not launch longer run or promote.

notes: One generation per arm per replicate. Same source, full original model/Target/Magnet/optimizer/RNG, within-replicate train seeds and budgets. Only historical opponents differ. Neither AQ nor Integrated Strategy targets a per-action reward change. Strategy is outside the exact training opponent pool; shared code or earlier teacher exposure not excluded.
